# repo-health

> Score a local repository checkout on docs, tests, CI, security and maintenance with ten weighted offline checks and a grade Python package `trysac-repo-health`, import name `repo_health`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
